ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Prior to acceptance of any structure, the proposed shareholders, directors, and ultimate beneficial owners must be screened against (i) the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, (ii) the OFAC SDN List, (iii) the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and (iv) the national lists published by the Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (MLTFCU) of Egypt. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) are subject to enhanced due diligence, including identification of family members and close associates, verification of source of funds, and ongoing monitoring in accordance with the risk-based approach prescribed by Law No. 80 of 2002 and FATF Recommendations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – 'InvesT Egypt' Electronic Company Registration and Name Clearance Portal (https://www.gafi.gov.eg)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The LLC's name must be in Arabic; the Arabic text is legally binding. An English transliteration is accepted for foreign registration and correspondence, provided it is a faithful phonetic transliteration that does not deviate from the Arabic original. Latin script-only names are generally rejected, except for internationally recognized foreign brands, and require GAFI's special approval.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the name is refused, GAFI issues a formal rejection letter. Within 30 days of the rejection letter, the applicant may submit an administrative appeal through the same portal attaching legal defenses and any ministerial approvals. GAFI's Name Clearance Committee must decide within 15 working days. If the appeal is denied, the applicant may contest the decision before the Administrative Court (Economic Court) in accordance with the Investment Law; during litigation, a temporary name may be reserved for the company's incorporation under judicial order.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices are not permissible for the registered commercial premises of an inspection/QC agency. GAFI and the commercial registry require a physical office with actual lease agreement, utilities connection, and evidence of business equipment; a virtual address cannot support the issuance of a license under the commercial inspection and testing regime.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High (approximately 90% within the first 12 months). GAFI, the Ministry of Investment, and sectoral regulators conduct unannounced on-site inspections to verify commercial substance and compliance with Law No. 80 of 2002, particularly for professional service companies.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff per GAFI fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Tax registration formalities (corporate income tax, VAT, withholding tax)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory fee; administrative handling fee

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 as amended by Law No. 158 of 2021, Articles 82-105 (Limited Liability Companies); Executive Regulation No. 96 of 1982; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and GAFI implementing decrees; Export and Import Control Law No. 118 of 1975 for ISIC 7120 inspection services.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - One-Stop Shop and Commercial Registry Department, Cairo
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation (Talbis Al-Tasiss) accompanied by the Arabic Articles of Association (Eita Al-Taasis) and the Internal Statute (Nizam Al-Sharika), submitted to the GAFI One-Stop Shop window of the company's seat governorate.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No pre-registration paid-up capital escrow is required for a service LLC whose capital is fixed at nominal value without cash contribution; if the founders elect an initial capital of EGP 50,000 under Article 82 of Law 159/1981, the cash portion must be deposited into a blocked bank escrow account in Egypt and released only after issuance of the commercial registration certificate. In-kind contributions must be fully assessed by an accredited valuer and legally transferred at registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) That the report of the incorporation agent be hereby noted, and the subscribers' representation as to the execution of the incorporation deed be ratified; (2) That upon issuance of the commercial registration number, the initial subscribed capital of the Company be approved by allotting shares to the founding members and depositing all cash contributions with the Company's designated bank account as required by law; (3) That the Company's registered office be and is hereby established at the address shown in the Articles of Association, and the Executive Managers responsible for daily management be appointed forthwith; (4) That the incorporation attorney is authorized to complete the statutory filings, pay fees, and obtain the commercial register extracts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Reservation and Legal Form Pre-Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Electronic Project Establishment Portal and Commercial Registry Name Search System
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the GAFI one-stop-shop e-portal, file the proposed Arabic trade name with an optional Latin transliteration, select the Limited Liability Company (LLC) form and the ISIC 7120 activity description, and request legal pre-clearance of the name. The system verifies the name against reserved and registered trademarks and regulated expressions before issuing a 30-day reservation certificate.
required_dossiers: Passport or national ID of each founding member
Signed name reservation request form generated by the GAFI portal
Activity code and industrial classification declaration (ISIC 7120)
Draft Articles of Association for preliminary consistency check
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for resemblance, the applicant may file two alternative names through the same portal and submit a complementary statement; a subsequent refusal may be appealed to the GAFI Complaints Unit within 15 days, and production of a prior trademark registration certificate may overturn the rejection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution, Notarization and Stamping of the Founding Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Competent Notary Public (Ma'dhuniyat) in the company's seat governorate, in coordination with GAFI-designated banks for escrow accounts
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute and authenticate the Arabic Articles of Association and internal statute before a general or specific notary public, affix the electronic stamp duty certificate issued by the Ministry of Finance, and complete the digital notarization log. Where the founders declare cash capital, open a blocked escrow account without online withdrawal rights in the company's name at a GAFI-designated bank, and secure the bank's escrow certificate for enclosure with the filing.
required_dossiers: Original Arabic Articles of Association in four counterparts
Internal Statute of the LLC
Notarial minutes confirming attendees and legality of execution
Ministry of Finance electronic stamp duty confirmation
Bank escrow certificate of the capital deposit, if any
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Should the notary reject the minutes because the lease contract is not attached or the capital declaration is unfounded, remedy by adding a supplementary notarized declaration of the founders and presenting the physical lease document; deficiencies in stamp duty are cured by paying the missing amount and the statutory delay surcharge at the bank window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of the GAFI Incorporation Dossier and Issue of the Commercial Registration Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop - Company Formation and Commercial Registration Department of the competent governorate
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Deliver the notarized founding corpus, name reservation certificate, lease contract of the registered office, and bank escrow evidence to the GAFI receiving window and obtain a time-stamped receipt showing the case number. The GAFI officer verifies the corporate articles, contact persons, and founding signatures; after payment of the statutory fees on the authorized EGP tariff, the commercial registration number and GAFI establishment certificate are issued and forwarded electronically to the Ministry of Investment databases.
required_dossiers: Notarized and stamped Articles of Association and statute
Name reservation certificate
Executive lease contract of the head office or usufruct title
Bank escrow certificate of the capital deposit, if applicable
Original national IDs or passports and power of attorney for the formation agent
Ministry of Investment electronic service form acknowledging fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a completion notice for missing documents, the applicant has a cure period of 14 calendar days in accordance with GAFI one-stop-shop regulations. Upon a second query, the application is administratively withdrawn and must be refiled with additional fees, unless a formal objection is lodged with the GAFI Dispute Resolution Committee together with evidence of full compliance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration (Tax Card and VAT Certificate)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) - competent tax office at the company head office's governorate
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 calendar days from commercial registration, submit the Tax Card application form together with the incorporation certificate and lease contract to the competent tax office. The officer records the commercial register number and tax file number, issues the Tax Card and VAT registration certificate, and assigns the electronic filing credentials for monthly VAT returns, corporate income tax declarations, and withholding tax statements.
required_dossiers: Commercial register extract and GAFI establishment certificate
Tax Card application completing the ETA prescribed form
Certified copy of the Articles of Association
Lease contract of the head office, if leased
Three recent passport photographs of the legal manager and signature card
Corporate bank account data sheet
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The typical delay is the ETA's physical inspection of the head office; if the survey shows that the premises are not equipped, apply for re-inspection within ten working days and present the fully furnished office. If the Tax Card is suspended due to prior arrears of the founders, attach a notarized confirmation of the new legal personality and request a file transfer.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Social Insurance, Manpower Workplace Registration and Civil Defense Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI), the Manpower Directorate of the Ministry of Manpower, and the General Administration of Civil Defense
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply to NOSI for the statutory company insurance number and register the designated administrative and technical staff on the electronic insurance list, completing the four-part registration code sheet. Simultaneously notify the Manpower Directorate of the establishment's operation and obtain the Occupational Safety and Health card. Secure Civil Defense clearance by initiating the fire safety certificate application, presenting the office layout, evacuation plan, fire extinguisher devices, and electrical grounding approval.
required_dossiers: Commercial registration extract and LLC establishment certificate
NOSI insurance registration form for the company and employees
Approved lease contract and office layout plan
Civil Defense application and fire safety checklist
Municipal structural safety or occupancy certificate
Manpower establishment notice and labor register
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Civil Defense checklist is rejected because the building's evacuation capacity is insufficient, remedy by contracting certified fire-system retrofit works and submitting the engineering completion certificate to the same administrative body. NOSI records may be rectified by submitting corrected payroll data within the 30-day grievance window, without penalty if reported before the first payroll run.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Governmental Qualifying Registration for the Inspection and Testing Trade (GOEIC and EGAC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Organization for Export and Import Control (GOEIC) and the Egyptian Accreditation Council (EGAC) under the Ministry of Trade and Industry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The inspection agency must be entered into GOEIC's registry of conformity assessment providers to perform pre-shipment factory audits and technical testing under the Export and Import Control Law, while maintaining technical competence. If an on-site laboratory is established, the company must obtain EGAC accreditation as a Testing Laboratory (ISO/IEC 17025) or Inspection Body (ISO/IEC 17020) within the prescribed period. The operating methodology, including sampling, reporting, and impartiality, must be documented in the quality manual, and professional indemnity insurance of at least USD 500,000 must be presented.
required_dossiers: Commercial register, tax card, and social insurance certificates
Quality manual of conformity assessment procedures
Credentials of the technical manager and testing personnel
Description of the physical office and laboratory equipment, if any
Liability insurance policy of not less than USD 500,000
GOEIC application forms and consent letter to comply with sector rules
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: GOEIC rejection letters must cure technical competence findings by replacing the technical manager with a registered engineer from an endorsed list or by outsourcing laboratory testing to a licensed facility; any administrative refusal is subject to the internal appeal procedure provided under GOEIC implementing regulations concerning conformity assessment providers.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: General Organization for Export and Import Control (GOEIC) and the Industrial Development Authority (IDA) of the Ministry of Trade and Industry, coordinated with the Egyptian Accreditation Council (EGAC) for inspection and testing accreditation
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: GOEIC Registry Permit for Conformity Assessment Bodies (Pre-Shipment Inspection and Technical Testing), together with EGAC Accreditation Certificate for Inspection Body ISO/IEC 17020 or Testing Laboratory ISO/IEC 17025, as applicable; administrative industrial registration is not required for non-manufacturing audit premises unless a physical laboratory is installed.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C - environmental registration only. The wholly office-based QC inspection activity does not require a full EIA under Law No. 4 of 1994 and its Executive Regulations; registration with the EEAA becomes mandatory if a single analytical laboratory is installed or if sample destruction exceeds 5 kg per day.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharged to the municipal sewer must not exceed BOD 600 mg/L, COD 700 mg/L, and total suspended solids 400 mg/L under Law No. 93 of 1962. Laboratory extract ventilation stacks must keep total volatile organic compounds at or below 60 mg/m³. Solid analytical waste, including solvent residues and contaminated consumables, is classified as hazardous waste and must be transferred through an EEAA-licensed carrier using the official manifest system to a permitted disposal facility.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification and civil defense approval must be obtained from the General Administration of Civil Defense under Law No. 12 of 1983, covering automatic extinguishers, exit signage, and an approved evacuation plan for the office premises, together with a structural-load occupancy certificate from the municipal engineer. Occupational clearance is issued by the Ministry of Manpower after an establishment occupational safety and health file has been opened, a periodic work environment measurement plan for lighting, noise, and chemical exposure has been lodged, and the annual employee medical examination protocol has been contracted under Article 230 of the Labor Law No. 12 of 2003.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) - official portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities and local branches must obtain a Tax Identification Number (TIN) by registering with the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) through the unified electronic registration portal. The procedure requires submission of certified constitutional documents, proof of foreign registration, appointment of a resident tax representative or local branch manager, commercial register extract, and a valid power of attorney. ETA issues a unified tax ID card integrating income tax, VAT, and stamp tax registration. Non-resident entities deriving Egyptian-source income must also register for withholding tax purposes and, for VAT, must register if conducting taxable supplies in Egypt, subject to the statutory threshold.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Egypt's tax law does not provide a check-the-box regime. Corporations and limited liability companies are subject to corporate income tax at the entity level. Certain joint-stock and LLC structures may elect to be treated as investment funds or special-purpose vehicles only where explicitly permitted under the Investment Guarantees and Incentives Law and the Income Tax Law, subject to ETA approval. Hybrid mismatch rules per the OECD BEPS framework are recognized only through tax treaties and domestic anti-avoidance provisions; no elective mismatch regime applies.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual taxable turnover for goods and services; EGP 1,000,000 annual threshold for services-only suppliers under Executive Regulations of VAT Law No. 67 of 2016, as amended.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Egypt has implemented a mandatory e-invoicing and e-receipt system administered by the ETA. Taxable persons registered under VAT must integrate their billing systems with the ETA's electronic invoice portal through secure APIs (either direct API integration or certified ERP providers). Invoices must be transmitted in real time for fiscal clearance and digital stamping; the ETA assigns a unique QR code and invoice UUID. Failure to integrate or submit required data fields results in rejection and administrative penalties.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods and services from Egypt are generally zero-rated for VAT purposes. The eligible exporter must be a VAT-registered person, must maintain a valid export contract, and must prove that the goods left Egypt or the services were performed and consumed outside Egypt. Services physically rendered in Egypt to a non-resident for use outside Egypt, including inspection and quality-control testing services performed on goods destined for export, may qualify for zero rating if the foreign recipient bears the cost and the benefit is realized abroad, subject to ETA guidelines.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Inward Remittance Certificate or proof of foreign currency transfer showing settlement in the exporter's Egyptian bank account
Copy of the underlying export contract and purchase order
ETA-approved e-invoice with zero-rated VAT code
Certificate of Origin where required by destination customs
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Egyptian customs and tax authorities conduct rigorous post-clearance audits of export zero-rating claims. Fraudulent or unsupported zero-rating claims trigger repayment of input VAT recovered, additional tax at the standard VAT rate with late-payment interest, and monetary penalties under the VAT Law and Income Tax Law. Criminal penalties apply for forged export documents or false declarations, including imprisonment and fines. The Minister of Finance and customs authorities may impose retrospective clawbacks for claims older than five years where fraud or gross negligence is proven, with no time limit for fraudulent acts.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) - the sole monetary authority and banking supervisor exercising exclusive foreign exchange regulation under Law No. 88 of 2003 (Central Bank, Banking Sector, and Monetary System Law) as amended by Decree-Law No. 162 of 2022; all FX transactions must be routed through CBE-licensed banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt exited the managed-peg exchange system on 6 March 2024 and now operates a CBE-supervised flexible exchange-rate regime; current-account convertibility (inspection/testing fee income, subcontractor remittance, trade settlements) is liberalized subject to underlying-documentation verification by the executing bank. Capital-account convertibility is restricted but workable: foreign equity injections, dividend remittances, and parent-loan repayments require GAFI registration under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017, a tax-clearance certificate, and compliance evidence lodged with CBE-licensed banks; no CBE pre-approval is required post-flexible regime, but bank-led transaction monitoring (GOAML reporting) and ETA foreign-currency purchase checks apply.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: CBE revised circulars effective 2024 abolish mandatory conversion and surrender of export receipts; exporters may lawfully retain 100% of proceeds in domiciled foreign-currency accounts. Statutory repatriation timeline: service-export proceeds (including pre-shipment inspection and quality-control fees) must be credited to a CBE-licensed bank within 180 days from invoice/service-completion date; a bank-approved extension of up to 90 additional days is available, and uncollected balances must be reported to CBE, subjecting the entity to Law 88/2003 penalties.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Qatar National Bank Al Ahly (QNB AlAhly)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW-MEDIUM as a primary treasury rail; MEDIUM as an ancillary collection channel. Offshore digital EMIs (Wise Business, Payoneer, Airwallex) may collect inspection fee receivables from non-resident clients, but they cannot hold EGP and cannot function as the Egyptian treasury account without violating the CBE licensing regime under Law 88/2003. All EGP conversion and inbound/outbound settlement must be finalized in the name of the EG LLC through a CBE-licensed bank; credits arriving via Wise are treated as ordinary MT103 payments and are fully subject to KYC checks, GOAML reporting, and the Egyptian sourcing rules for foreign-currency purchases.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: CBE Anti-Money Laundering Decree No. 17 of 2020 requires completion of customer-due-diligence interviews. In practice, Egyptian banks mandate at least one authorized director or a duly appointed attorney-in-fact (holding a notarized and apostilled power of attorney) to attend a physical interview at the branch when opening a corporate account for an LLC; fully remote account opening is not permitted, although video-KYC may supplement the mandatory initial physical visit. The complete file must include: commercial register extract, tax card/TIN certificate, articles of association, UBO declaration chart, board resolution designating account signatories, source-of-funds statement, and GAFI licensing documents under Law 72/2017.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO structure involving non-resident offshore intermediary shareholders that triggers enhanced due diligence (EDD) under CBE risk classification models.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Ultimate natural-person UBO chart, apostilled and legalized memorandum and articles of association for each intermediate entity, certificate of incorporation and certificate of incumbency, complete share register, source-of-funds declarations for each UBO, and an independent licensed compliance opinion confirming no sanctions exposure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between the licensed scope of business (ISIC 7120 inspection/testing) and high-frequency, small-value SWIFT credits originating from multiple foreign factories, which may resemble unrelated third-party flows.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Validated commercial register naming inspection and testing activities, executed framework service agreements with named factory clients, inspection work-order logs, sample pre-shipment inspection reports, invoice schedule mapping every expected inward credit, and bank reference letters from the foreign parent or clients.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Request for multiple remote signatories resident outside Egypt combined with bulk foreign-currency disbursements to overseas subcontractor laboratories, presenting money-laundering red flags on control and fund destination.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolution containing a signatory authority limits matrix, apostilled powers of attorney for each remote signatory, complete subcontractor KYC files (registration, tax IDs, professional certifications), executed subcontracting agreements, and quarterly fund-flow reconciliations prepared by the external auditor.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital injection from a cross-border parent jurisdiction flagged as a higher-risk FDI source, creating potential blocked-credit and repatriation complications.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: GAFI-issued investment registration certificate for the EG LLC under Law 72/2017, capital-call board resolution, bank statement from the parent evidencing the remittance path, updated share-allotment ledger, and a written MT103 purpose-tag protocol (INVC) accompanied by a compliance cover letter to the receiving bank's KYC desk.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Execute as SWIFT MT103 from the parent bank via correspondent/CHIPS into the EG LLC capital escrow account held at NBE or CIB. Remittance information (tag 70) must carry the purpose code INVC / Capital Contribution, cite the LLC Commercial Registration number and Egyptian articles of association, and clearly identify the GAFI registration reference; CBE pre-approval is not required, but the receiving bank must file the operation in the CBE transaction-monitoring system and confirm FDI registration with GAFI before crediting the escrow and before any future dividend repatriation entitlements are granted.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rails: (1) SWIFT MT103 for international subcontractor fees, testing equipment purchases, and licensing royalties, settled through the bank's USD/EUR nostro network; (2) EGP RTGS for domestic operational payments including salaries, permits, and utilities; (3) Commercial Letter of Credit (SWIFT MT700) reserved for high-value calibrated inspection equipment exceeding USD 20,000 where supplier security instruments are required. Every EGP-to-foreign-currency conversion requires underlying contractual and invoicing documentation per CBE rules, with bank records referencing the applicable invoice and inspection contract.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable EGP/USD outright forwards with CBE-licensed banks, backed by a committed inspection-fee order book; typical margin 10% cash collateral, tenor up to 365 days
EGP/USD short-term FX swaps for liquidity clearing executed with the primary relationship bank
EGP/USD cross-currency swaps for the parent-loan capital structure, subject to CBE written consent where tenor exceeds one year
Offshore USD/EGP non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for the non-resident parent as a hedge overlay; the Egyptian entity itself is prohibited from executing NDFs on CBE deliverable markets

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax annual return and audited financial statements attachment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after the end of the fiscal year; for a calendar-year LLC, no later than 30 April of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fee of 25% of tax due if filed more than 30 days after deadline; monthly late-payment charge of 2.5% on unpaid tax; continued default triggers forced collection, suspension of tax clearance, and administrative deregistration from the commercial register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited financial statements presented to shareholders and filed with the Commercial Registry/GAFI
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry Office under the General Authority for Investment (GAFI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders must approve annual accounts within 3 months of fiscal year end; audited financial statements and minutes of the General Assembly must be filed with the Commercial Registry within 30 days after approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines imposed on directors and legal representatives for failure to convene the annual general meeting or file audited accounts; repeated non-compliance exposes the company to administrative strike-off and litigation file initiated by the Commercial Registrar.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of commercial registration certificate and municipal commercial license
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry Office / issuing Governorate Administration (Egyptian Ministry of Investment)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually during the last quarter of the calendar year, with final deadline of 31 December; if the registration is anniversary-based, renewal is due within 30 days before the annual expiry date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Delay fines accrue immediately after the statutory deadline; non-renewal beyond 90 days triggers suspension of the operating license, penalty surcharges, and eventual strike-off from the commercial register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) register and shareholder-transfer notifications
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment (GAFI) – Financial Registry for beneficial ownership and corporate notification
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation covering the prior calendar year due by 31 January; share transfer notifications must be submitted within 30 days of any shareholding change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance with UBO record-keeping and notification requirements incurs fines under Egyptian Anti-Money Laundering Law No. 80/2002; false entries may lead to criminal liability, disqualification of directors, and administrative strike-off in serious cases.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All Egyptian limited liability companies are statutorily required to appoint at least one licensed auditor, irrespective of revenue, assets, or headcount; there is no small-company exemption from the audit appointment obligation under Companies Law No. 159/1981. Full IFRS-grade audited statements are mandatory for listed entities and financial institutions, while non-listed LLCs file under Egyptian Accounting Standards.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), which converge with IFRS; listed companies and financial institutions must apply IFRS as endorsed by the Egyptian Financial Regulatory Authority.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The LLC must maintain a register of members and a separate UBO register at the registered office. Any share transfer must be recorded in the register of members within 15 days and notified to GAFI within 30 days, together with an updated UBO schedule. Annually, by 31 January, the company must confirm to GAFI that the UBO register is accurate and complete, and must attach the registered shareholder list and directors' declarations as part of the annual compliance statement.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Signed Contracts and Agencies

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250 – USD 650 per year depending on governorate and serviced-office arrangements
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,200 – USD 3,800 per year for a small/mid-sized inspection and commercial testing agency with revenue below EGP 20 million

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory 5-year corporate income tax holiday for qualifying projects in Free Zones and the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZone); 0% CIT on qualifying export and investment zone income; 50% deduction of investment cost for eligible new capital-intensive ventures under Investment Law 72/2017; treaty-based rate reductions for foreign shareholders.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form No. 9 (Corporate Income Tax Return) filed electronically via the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) e-filing portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within four months after the end of the fiscal year (fiscal year aligned to calendar year or the LLC's registered accounting period)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: ETA tax card number, legal entity name, fiscal year, registration status, and industry classification code.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident companies with an Egyptian permanent establishment (PE) must first register with ETA and quote the PE registration number; pure foreign shareholders are not entered on this line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All gross income from on-site commercial inspection, pre-shipment testing, and quality control services, including fees, commissions, and invoice reimbursements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only income attributable to the Egyptian PE is declared; offshore services rendered without a PE are excluded from this line unless treated as Egyptian-source income under the Income Tax Law.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory deductions for salaries, rents, equipment depreciation, accredited laboratory costs, professional fees, insurance, and travel expenses evidenced by compliant invoices and payroll records.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: PE costs must be booked and paid through Egyptian books; head-office cross-charges must satisfy arm's length standards and ETA transfer pricing documentation requirements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add-back of disallowed expenses, provisions, and non-deductible items; deduction of capital allowances and previously unrecognized amortization; adjustment for foreign exchange gains on commercial unrelated trade debt.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Treaty profit attribution rules and PE income apportionment adjustments are recorded on this line; no treaty claim is available for non-PE foreign dividends.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of taxable profit after adjustments; application of the 22.5% corporate rate; subtraction of investment incentives, foreign tax credits, and previously paid advance tax installments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a PE, this line computes the final Egyptian CIT liability; reduced dividend withholding treaty rates are not applied on this line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net of quarterly advance payments, withholding tax credits, and estimated paid CIT; final payable amount to ETA treasury or refund claim.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach the Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) and supporting evidence when foreign tax credits or treaty relief are claimed against PE income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Disclosure of related-party transaction types, aggregate values, selection of arm's length methodology, and confirmations of contemporaneous documentation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mandatory when related-party transactions exceed EGP 10,000,000 in the fiscal year; the Egyptian entity must retain Master File and Local File and present them on ETA demand.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: fixed penalty of EGP 1,000 to EGP 5,000 plus a monthly delay surcharge of 2% on the assessed tax for each month or part of a month of delay; under-declaration penalty up to 20% of the additional tax assessed; criminal fines and imprisonment for willful evasion; travel bans on directors for non-payment of confirmed corporate tax liabilities.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The non-resident shareholder must obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from its residence jurisdiction, file a DTA relief request with the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) evidencing shareholding and beneficial ownership, and secure ETA approval before dividend payment; the Egyptian LLC payer must retain the approved relief letter to apply the reduced treaty rate, otherwise the statutory 10% withholding is collected and settled to the ETA.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: royalties on intellectual property 20%; interest on debt instruments 20%. Treaty rates generally 10% to 12% for royalties and 10% to 15% for interest, subject to TRC submission, beneficial ownership confirmation, and limitation-on-benefits clauses in the applicable Egypt DTA.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EGP 10,000,000 aggregate related-party transactions per fiscal year to trigger mandatory Master File and Local File preparation; Country-by-Country Report required for multinational groups with consolidated group revenue of EGP 20,000,000,000 or more.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt does not apply a UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) statute; however, general anti-avoidance rules (GAAR) and substance-over-form doctrines under Income Tax Law 91/2005 require the LLC to maintain real premises, employees, contracts, independent decision-making, and commercial substance in Egypt. Beneficial ownership is mandatory for treaty relief; shell entities with no genuine economic activity are disregarded and recharacterized by the ETA.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Willfully concealing inspection and testing revenues, fabricating service agreements, issuing backdated invoices, or filing Form No. 9 with materially false profit figures to evade corporate income tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal prosecution before the Economic Courts; imprisonment of 1 to 5 years; fines up to EGP 50,000; confiscation of the evaded tax amounts; reinstatement of the full CIT plus monthly 2% delay surcharges and late-filing penalties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The ETA pierces the corporate veil: directors are jointly and severally liable for civil restitution of evaded tax, subject to travel bans, asset freeze orders, passport seizure, and imprisonment for the responsible officers.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the LLC as a hollow booking entity with no Egyptian physical presence, staff, or genuine commercial decisions while stripping profits to non-resident affiliates through inflated management fees, overpriced sub-contracting, or artificial cost recharges.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ETA disregards the artificial arrangement under GAAR, recharacterizes related-party transactions, disallows artificial deductions, reassesses CIT at the 22.5% rate, imposes administrative penalties of up to 100% of the additional tax, and if applicable denies tax treaty benefits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Civil veil-lifting under the Egyptian Companies Law and Civil Code; directors personally liable for unpaid corporate tax debts, mandated travel bans, asset sequestration, and debarment from serving as directors in Egypt.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving wire transfer or Wise payments from sanctioned counterparties, deliberately structuring cash or wire payments to avoid AML thresholds, or failing to maintain beneficial ownership registers and customer due diligence files for inspection-service clients.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to EGP 20,000,000 and imprisonment up to 15 years under AML Law 80/2002 as amended by Law 154/2019; confiscation of the funds linked to the offense; freezing of corporate and personal bank accounts; publication of enforcement measures.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the appointed AML compliance officer bear personal criminal liability, face travel bans and passport suspension, asset forfeiture orders, and permanent disqualification from corporate management in Egypt.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to prepare and retain the Master File and Local File when controlled transactions exceed the EGP 10,000,000 threshold, or applying non-arm's length commissions, margins, or fee rates to inspection and QC services charged to foreign related parties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Transfer pricing audit adjustment to the arm's-length profit level; additional CIT at 22.5%; dedicated TP penalty of 20% of the adjusted tax; monthly 2% delay surcharge on all late-paid amounts; official publication of the adjustment order.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who certified the related-party disclosure and financial statements as accurate are personally fined for intentional non-disclosure, held civilly liable for restitution of the TP penalties, and subjected to travel bans until the assessed liabilities are settled.
